## Plugin reference

- Description: transcodeToBudget(input, budgetBytes, { signal, outDir }): re-encode a video to an MP4 of at most budgetBytes — ffprobe for duration and sound, two-pass H.264 at budget·8·0.95/duration − 128k AAC, +faststart, size checked after — answering fits | too-long (the picture would get < 300 kbps, nothing encoded) | over-budget.
